name: cg-dynamics
description_for_human: Private CG Production House operating remote: brief yourself from your CG Assistant profile, see today's work, retrieve exact-client context, close out content runs, and draft governed lead follow-ups. Staff workspace only.
description_for_model: Private, single-workspace assistant surface for CG Production House staff. All live data, authorization and actions come from the registered CG Dynamics MCP connection — this package only supplies the workflow skills. Always work from the exact signed-in staff identity and exact client scope; never infer identity, client facts, contacts, tasks, schedules or media state, and never fabricate a live connection. Prefer live retrieval over stale ChatGPT Project memory. Email is DRAFT-ONLY; never send.
starter_prompts: Brief yourself from my CG Assistant profile.
I'm done with Red Oak's shoot.
Check whether today's footage is uploaded.
Research this lead and draft the follow-up email.
notes: This is a private workspace plugin. The `apps` / `.app.json` MCP mapping is intentionally omitted here: it is added only after the real CG Dynamics MCP connection is created in ChatGPT Developer mode and a real `plugin_asdk_app...` technical ID exists. See ../CONNECTION-HANDOFF.md. Do not add a placeholder connector ID.
